item.text:
I can’t save the pair as one canonical Result. The RoB workflow accepts at most one Result card per Trial, and each card’s group values hold one statistic. Validation rejected both the paired values in one card and two cards for LATITUDE. No proposal change was saved, so the grade 3/4 adverse-event proposal remains pending. No risk-of-bias assessment was done.

The article reports the pair separately: **grade 3 hypertension**, 121 (20) vs 59 (10); **grade 3 hypokalemia**, 57 (10) vs 7 (1). It does not report a joint count for the pair. To record both comparisons canonically, the workflow would need to support multiple outcomes per Trial or multiple statistics per group.
